assessment: The Q3 rebound, weaker fiscal receipts and 8.7% COLA were concrete successful calls. The proposed bill/RRP funding channel subsequently operated, while its conditional Treasury-liquidity warning must retain the explicit offsets. Pipeline and Cigna performance observations are verified but retrospective. The NIIP framework is useful when equity valuation effects and sector ownership are kept distinct from debt repayment capacity. Gold and China admissions deserve equal visibility with successful observations.
